title: Missed-optimization instance
description: One issue given to the agent. Written by the Task 2 driver, one file per issue.

issue_id.description: Unique across the whole dataset (all missed-optimization techniques), e.g. 'missed_opt-0017'.

metadata.description: Optional free-form fields, e.g. source URL, LLVM commit, optimization category.
